name: Guildmaster Brea
bio: The outgoing Guildmaster of Brightmoor's adventurers' guild in Lanternhall. Thirty days to find a successor.

portrait.subject: a cute retired adventurer guildmaster woman with silver-streaked braids, an eyepatch, a warm smile, a quill behind her ear and a stack of quest papers
portrait.background: busy cosy adventurers' guild hall with notice boards and lanterns

request: Brea, Guildmaster of Lanternhall. You're the new clerk? Good. Friends, then. 📋
hello: Excellent. Grade dangers honestly and we'll get on fine.
Wild Folk pay in acorns. Accept the acorns.
about: I'm Brea. I've run Brightmoor's guild for twenty years. In thirty days it needs a new Guildmaster. You might be it.
how: Sit behind the quest desk: read petitions, grade the danger with the Guild Handbook, assign adventurers, and grow the guild in thirty days.
tips: Creature + number + place + omen. Add it up honestly.
Rotate your adventurers. Tired ones fail.
chat: A goose filed a quest against another goose.
The Crown wants a dragon 'gently relocated'.
Copper rookies broke the training dummy. Again.
Found an acorn in my tea. The Wild Folk pay early.
nudge: A tricky quest came in. Your call.
idle: The desk's been unattended for {ago}! Papers everywhere!
{ago}, clerk! The adventurers are getting rowdy.
progress: Day {day} of 30! The guild's in good hands. 📋

questions.q: How do you grade a quest about '3 wolves in a dark forest'?
a: Bit low. Dark forests count extra.
Very cautious! Nobody gets hurt, at least.

update: Guild bulletin: Lanternhall updated to v{version}!
